html:
Given nonnegative capacity, process [put,key,value] and [get,key]. Keys and values are integers. Return all get results, with None for misses. Successful get and put make a key most recent; evict the least recent when needed.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    2,
    [
      [
        "put",
        1,
        7
      ],
      [
        "put",
        2,
        8
      ],
      [
        "get",
        1
      ],
      [
        "put",
        3,
        9
      ],
      [
        "get",
        2
      ],
      [
        "get",
        3
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    7,
    null,
    9
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0,
    [
      [
        "put",
        1,
        2
      ],
      [
        "get",
        1
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    null
  ]
}
Hint

An ordered mapping tracks recency and supports endpoint eviction.

Complexity: O(n) expected time, O(capacity) space plus output
